title: Azusawa Kohane — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane...!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Morning, everyone!
Let's do our best again today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. After all, the practices we do each day mean everything to us now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, the light turned green.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, I noticed that you're wearing your uniform a little differently now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right. I thought it might be nice to try something new since it's not like our uniforms are changing this year.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, coming up with a new look's really hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping that I could give off a different impression like how you styled it, An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She didn't “style” it so much as just mess it up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't go raining on my parade.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, Kohane, which do you prefer?
My old look or my new one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... I thought your old look was cool since it felt so clean and tidy. It really suited you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think I prefer your new look since it feels more fun and relaxed. I think it captures you better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A bunch of people in class told me the same thing, but it means so much more coming from you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've gotten Kohane's seal of approval, I'm gonna make the most of my uniform by wearing it as cutely and freely as I can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Freely...?
Says the former hall monitor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh? I don't think it's that odd. I'm actually impressed by how she followed the rules before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Toya gets it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I was a hall monitor, I know where the lines are in terms of what's okay and not okay. I plan on enjoying my uniform while following the rules.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Plus, you're on the broadcasting committee now. You'll get to play music by your favorite groups and make your school an even more fun place to be.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
I can't wait to start doing that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What about you, Kohane?
Has the cleanup committee already begun meeting?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we met just the other day and planted flowers in the flower bed together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The cleanup committee's responsible for that at Miya Girls?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's the greening committee's job at our school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: According to our committee chair, it all started after some students who are alumni now decided to help the school custodian with the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The custodian then suggested that they should choose some flowers to plant since it'd probably make things more fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what flowers did you guys plant?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Marigolds and snapdragons.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, great choice!
I love marigolds!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I forget what snapdragons look like. Gimme a sec to search them up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, An, wait...!
You might not want to do that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Because they become kind of scary when they go to seed during the fall...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
S-Scary? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I've read about them in a book before. Apparently, their seed pods form holes in a way that makes them look like little skulls...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, they do look like skulls...
And there's one for every flower. Creepy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why some people became a little worried when they came up as a candidate...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But they spread their seeds in the fall, so we figured that the skulls could work as decorations for Halloween if they were to form at the right time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't you think these look a little too realistic for that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree... They may not be ghosts, but you might want to avoid looking at these, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That only makes me want to look at them even more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, why not just get it over with?
Boo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's the big idea?! You're gonna make Kohane's kindness all go to waste!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
The flowers themselves are really cute, so I'll show you some photos of them later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
